grain.en: This could contain vegetables and grains and, if times were good, maybe a little bit of meat or fish.
grain.zh: 这可能包含蔬菜和谷物，如果赶上好时候，也许还有一点肉或鱼。

growth.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
growth.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

gradually.en: They brought their own food traditions with them, and these foods have gradually become part of British life.
gradually.zh: 他们带来了他们自己的饮食传统，这些食物逐渐成为英国生活的一部分。
